mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.5% and manufacturing production (INDPRO) falls below its 3-month moving average, it indicates a dual stress in the labor market and industrial sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 6.5 and INDPRO < 3mo_MA.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), a monthly increase in the federal funds rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals aggressive monetary tightening, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to expected earnings contraction.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1.5% from the prior month indicates strengthening consumer demand and residential investment, which typically precedes positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases by >1.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 0.5% from the prior month indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by >0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer spending (RSAFS > 500,000 million dollars), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) below its 3-month moving average signals a weakening in the housing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS > 500000 and HOUST < 3mo_MA.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% year-over-year, combined with a stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), indicates persistent inflation without monetary accommodation, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a prolonged inflationary environment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5.
